message.content:
The U.S. Declaration of Independence was signed by **56 delegates** from the thirteen colonies on **July 4, 1776** (the signing actually took place on August 2, 1776). The signers were:

| State | Signers |
|-------|---------|
| **Delaware** | George Read, Caesar Rodney, Thomas McKean |
| **Pennsylvania** | John Morton, George Clymer, Benjamin Franklin, Robert Morris, George Taylor |
| **New Jersey** | William Franklin, John Witherspoon, Francis Hopkinson, John Hart, Abraham Clark |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Hancock, Samuel Adams, John Adams, Robert Treat Paine, Elbridge Gerry |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll of Carrollton |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Hooper, John Rutledge |
| **New Hampshire** | Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple, Matthew Thornton |
| **Virginia** | Richard Henry Lee, Francis Lightfoot Lee, Carter Braxton |
| **New York** | Philip Livingston, Francis Lewis, Lewis Morris |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |

These men represented the colonies and formally adopted the Declaration, declaring the colonies independent from Great Britain.
